reviews.review_title: Don’t waste your money
reviews.review_text:
I strongly advise to shop elsewhere. 
I am extremely disappointed with my experience.

My order was marked as delivered, but I never received it. Despite providing evidence that the parcel was not in my possession, my concerns were repeatedly dismissed rather than properly investigated.

What is most frustrating is the complete failure to deal with my complaint in a timely and professional manner. Communication has been slow, responses have been generic, and there has been little effort to resolve the issue.

Under UK consumer law, the seller is responsible for ensuring that goods are delivered to the customer. Simply stating that a parcel was delivered is not enough when the customer has not received it. Instead of accepting responsibility and working towards a fair resolution, the company has failed to meet its obligations.

I expected much better customer service and a prompt resolution.  Instead, I have been left out of pocket and forced to spend significant time pursuing a matter that should have been resolved quickly.

Based on my experience, I would not recommend this company. Poor customer service, failure to resolve a legitimate non -delivery claim, and a lack of accountability have made this an extremely frustrating experience.

reviews.review_title: I love TEMU
reviews.review_text:
I have had excellent experiences with TEMU.  One needs to pay attention to ALL the information in the product description.  Most clothing is polyester and because the items are coming from the Orient, if you are North American or European, for goodness sake look at the measurements to ensure you buy the correct size.  If you are ordering a product that is normally 4 or 5 times less than you would pay in other countries, then expect a lower quality product: that's just common sense.  If you are getting a bargain, but not a steal, then you are likely going to get a good quality item.  If you pay attention and think, you will likely have a good experience. If multiple sellers have the "same" item, again read the whole description; the items may not actually be the same.
Whenever I have had a bad experience, it has usually been my fault.  I've forgotten to measure something, or I've forgotten to read the description, but TEMU has always made me whole, either with store credit, refund, or reshipment of the item.  Generally it is not worth my while to send an item back, so if it usable I donate it.  
TEMU will give store credit for late items.  Remember that items delivered outside of China are delivered by local delivery services, the name of which is given at the top of your invoice page.  Be aware that Local Warehouse does not mean local to your city, or even the same country - at least not necessarily.  Local may mean on the same continent.  
Always contact TEMU to explain your issue.  Their customer service is excellent and they will try to resolve your issue.

They are useless and tell you what you already know, and if you ask for something other than "security issues", it's just stated again, just in different wording. 

I'll say it once again, do not buy from Temu. 

As for Temu's parent company, PDD Holdings, which has a long history of intense controversy, legal battles, and regulatory scrutiny regarding data security and corporate fraud.
